  1
 1  WHEREAS, the City Council afforded all persons interested in the
2  matter of the proposed amendments to the Inglewood Municipal Code, or in
3  any matter or subject related thereto, an opportunity to address the City
4  Council and be heard and to submit any testimony or evidence in favor or
5  against the proposed Code amendments; and,
6  WHEREAS, after taking public testimony and considering the issues,
7  the City Council determined that certain changes specified herein, should be
8  made to the text of Articles 1 and 19 of Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal
9  Code; and,
10  NOW, THEREFORE, THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF INGLEWOOD,
11  CALIFORNIA, DOES ORDAIN AS FOLLOWS:
12  SECTION 1.
13  1.  That the proposed zoning code amendment to modify regulations for off-
14  hour parking for major event patrons and tailgating citywide is
15  consistent with the intent of the Inglewood General Plan in that it
16  supports the following goals of the land use element:
17  a. Provides for the orderly development and redevelopment of the city
18  while preserving a measure of diversity among its parts.
19  b. Helps promote economic development and employment opportunities
20  for the City’s residents by responding to changing economic
21  conditions.
22  2.  The proposed zoning code amendment to modify regulations for off-hour
23  parking for major event patrons and tailgating citywide does not
24  constitute an establishment of unique standards, offering special
25  privilege to a particular individual or group of individuals because the
26  proposed amendment will expand economic opportunities to local
27  businesses and will provide regulation for an anticipated use.
28  3.  That the proposed zoning code amendment to modify regulations for off-

  2
 1  hour parking for major event patrons and tailgating citywide is exempt
2  from further review under the California Environmental Quality Act

3  because there is no possibility that a project may have a significant effect

4  on the environment, therefore Notice of Exemption EA-CE-2020-040 has

5  been prepared.

6  SECTION 2.

7  The text of Article 1 (Definitions), Section 12-1.123. of Chapter 12 of the

8  Inglewood Municipal Code is hereby modified to read as follows:

9  Section 12-1.122.5.3 Swap Meet.

10  SECTION 3.

11  The text of Article 1 (Definitions), Section 1.123. of Chapter 12 of the

12  Inglewood Municipal Code is hereby modified to read as follows:

13  Section 1-123.0. Tailgating.

14  “Tailgating” shall mean taking part in activities and congregating for

15  the purpose of an outdoor gathering by one or more people prior to a scheduled

16  event occurring at a major sports or entertainment facility.

17  SECTION 4.

18  The text of Article 19 (Parking Regulations), Section 12-42. (‘Required

19  Parking. Exceptions.’) of Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code is hereby

20  modified to read as follows:

21  Section 12-42. Required Parking. Exceptions.

22  Notwithstanding the provisions of this Article:

23  (G) Off-Hour Parking for Major Event Patrons. Any business, located

24  along the following major arterials as defined by the Circulation Element of

25  the Inglewood General Plan:

26    Arbor Vitae Street

27    Centinela Avenue

28    Century Boulevard

  3
 1    Crenshaw Boulevard
2    Florence Avenue
3    Hawthorne Boulevard
4    Imperial Highway
5    La Brea Avenue
6    La Cienega Boulevard
7    Manchester Boulevard
8    Prairie Avenue
9  within one thousand five hundred feet of a major sports or entertainment
10  facility that can accommodate at least ten thousand patrons, may permit
11  patrons of a major sports or entertainment facility which seats 10,000 or more
12  to park for a fee upon the parking lot of the subject business, provided that the
13  subject business has obtained current and proper permit(s), to charge a fee for
14  parking, from the Permits and Licenses Committee as provided in Chapter 8
15  of this Code; and meets the following requirements:
16  (1) A minimum of ten (10) parking spaces will be provided; and
17  (2) Complies with one of the following:
18  a. The normal business activities, for which the parking lot is
19  required, shall have ceased at least one hour before the major
20  sports or entertainment event commences; or and
21  b. The parking spaces to be utilized for Major Event Parking are
22  available in excess of code requirements for the subject site of
23  the business; or
24  c. Approval of a Special Use Permit (SUP) for Shared Parking
25  for Major Event Attendees (Section 12-47.1).
26  (3) Tailgating shall be permitted on properties that are contained within
27  a block that is located within one-mile of Hollywood Park, subject to
28  Permits and Licenses Committee approval. Tailgating shall be
  subject to the following requirements:

  4
 1
2  a. Shall only be permitted on non-residential developed
3  properties with a valid Major Event Parking License and
4  Tailgating License approved by the Permits and Licenses
5  Committee; and
6  b. Except where located on a major sports or entertainment
7  facility site, tailgating shall only be permitted prior to a
8  sporting event to be held at SoFi Stadium; and
9  c. Only permitted on surface lots, not permitted in any parking
10  structures or garages;
11  d. Shall not encroach or obstruct any public right-of-way,
12  including public streets, alleys, sidewalks, and parkways;
13  and
14  e. Shall not obstruct any required parking spaces or access to
15  required parking spaces; and
16  f. Shall be restricted to start no earlier than 7:00 a.m. or four
17  (4) hours prior to the start time of a scheduled event,
18  whichever is earlier, and to end when the scheduled sporting
19  event has begun; and
20  g. All tailgating areas must be cleaned up prior to the start of
21  the scheduled event; and
22  h. Prohibited items and/or activities include:
23  i. Recreational vehicles and/or trailers exceeding a size
24  of 9 feet by 18 feet
25  ii. Overnight parking
26  iii. Amplified sound
27  iv. Drinking Games
28  v. Kegs

  5
 1  vi. Glass containers. All drinks shall be placed in plastic
2  or other non-breakable cups or cans
3  vii. Generators (greater than 600W)
4  viii. Charcoal BBQs and Grills
5  ix. Any cooking that results in substantive amounts of
6  smoke
7  x. Deep fryers or any oil-based cooking
8  xi. Open fires or flames
9  xii. Drones
10  xiii. Megaphones, airhorns, and other noise making devices
11  xiv. Sale of food or beverage items
12  xv. Sale of items or soliciting of any promotional or
13  marketing activities
14  (2) The subject business has obtained current and proper permit(s), to
15  charge a fee for parking, from the Committee on Permits and
16  Licenses as provided in Chapter 8 of this Code.
17  SECTION 5.
18  Section 12-47.1. (‘Shared Parking for Major Event Attendees.’) is hereby
19  added to the text of Article 19, Chapter 12 of the Inglewood Municipal Code to
20  read as follows:
21  Section 12-47.1. Shared Parking for Major Event Attendees.
22  Any business located along a major arterial that is unable to comply with 12-
23  42 (G)(2)(a) or (b) may request approval of a Special Use Permit by the
24  Planning Commission to allow shared parking for major event attendees
25  subject to the following limitation:
26  (1) A parking utilization study, prepared and certified by a licensed civil
27  engineer, that demonstrates the availability of a minimum of ten
28  parking spaces for major event attendees shall be submitted to the

  6
 1  Planning Division as proof that a parking analysis that complies with
2  the Code provisions has been prepared.
3  SECTION 6.
4  The City Clerk shall certify to the passage and adoption of this
5  ordinance and to its approval by the City Council and shall cause the same to
6  be published in accordance with the City Charter and thirty days from the
7  final passage and adoption, this ordinance shall be in full force and effect.
8  This ordinance to amend Articles 1 and 19 of Chapter 12 (Planning and
9  Zoning) of the Inglewood Municipal Code to modify regulations for off-hour

10  parking for major event patrons and tailgating citywide is passed, approved

11  and adopted by the City Council of the City of Inglewood this __________ day

12  of _____________ 2021.
